{"consolidated_memory":"Component: billing/webhooks/stripe.py (webhook consumer for duplicate charge handling)
Test coverage: tests/billing/test_stripe_webhook.py
Stack: Python

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-01]
Problem: Duplicate charge in webhook consumer
Reproduction: Redeliver the same webhook id twice
Signal: Two ledger rows sharing one event id
Trigger condition: Only appeared for users in negative UTC offset
Root cause: Cache entry was never invalidated on write
Fix: Invalidated cache entry inside the write transaction
Deployed via: PR #4860 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-1
Outcome: Backlog cleared 71 minutes after deploy

INCIDENT 2 [2026-04-11]
Problem: Duplicate charge in webhook consumer
Reproduction: Redeliver the same webhook id twice
Signal: Two ledger rows sharing one event id
Trigger condition: Only appeared for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: Error swallowed by bare except clause
Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
Deployed via: PR #9987 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-2
Outcome: p99 latency improved from 3.5 s to 520 ms

Summary: Two distinct occasions with the same observable symptom (duplicate charges and shared event IDs) but different environmental/structural triggers (UTC offset vs. input depth) and different underlying causes (cache invalidation vs. exception handling). Each required targeted fixes with measurable improvements to different metrics."}
